data.content_ref: inline:{"analogy":null,"claim":"15% of 80 equals 12, by transposing the operands and computing 80% of 15.","counterconditions":[{"case":"If the commutative property is misapplied to division (e.g., 80 / (15/100) yielding 533.3).","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"},{"case":"If the operands are transposed but the percentage operator is not adjusted (e.g., computing 80 + 15 instead of 80% of 15).","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"},{"case":"If the decimal representation of 80% is misidentified (e.g., 0.08).","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"}],"definitions":[],"derivation":[],"formalization_refs":[],"mechanism":"The expression x * y / 100 is commutative, so 15 * 80 / 100 is equivalent to 80 * 15 / 100. 80% of 15 is 0.8 * 15 = 12.","premises":[],"schema":"deepreason-reasoning-envelope-v1","scope":{"covers":[],"excludes":[]},"simulation_refs":[],"uncertainties":[]}
